(1v) siddham namas tārāyai ||
[1.1] ihāyam ācāryaśāntidevaḥ parān bodhisattvasaṃvare ’vatārayitum ātmānaṃ ca tatra sthirīkartuṃ bodhicaryāvatāraṃ kartukāma ādau sadācārānuparipālanādyarthaṃ sugatān ityādy āha | atra śloke ratnatrayasya vandyānām upādhyāyaprabhṛtīnāṃ ca praṇatir abhidheyaṃ tatsaṃbandhaḥ prayojanam asvātantryam apaunaruktyam iti ṣaḍ arthāḥ pratipāditāḥ |
tatra sugatātmajasaṃvaro ’bhidheyam | asya ca granthenāmunābhidhānam | abhidhānā bhidheyabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ sāmarthyagamyaḥ | asya cābhidheyasya buddhatvaṃ pariniṣṭhitaṃ prayojanaṃ gamyam | śeṣaṃ sugamam | sarvopadhivinirmukto dharmakāyaḥ | adhigamapravacanaṃ vā dharmaḥ |
etac cābhidheyādikaṃ prekṣāvatāṃ pravṛttyaṅgatvād ādāv avaśyābhidhānīyam | ratnatrayādipraṇatir api puṇyaṃ prasuvānā tadviruddham apuṇyaṃ viruṇaddhīti granthakartṛvyākhyātṛśrotṝṇām ārabdhakaraṇavyākhyānaśravaṇāni (2 deest) (3r) [1.15]trānuśaṃsaṃ gotrabhūmyādibhedenānekaprakāratve ’pi samāsāt | [1.20] idam ity avicchinnapuṇyatvam |
hīne śrāvakādiyāne | adhimuktiḥ śraddhā chando vā | [1.21–22] śiraḥśūlāpanayanaṃ mantreṇauṣadhena vā | gṛhyate smeti pūrvaval laṭ | kimutety atiśayena | śūlam iva śūlam apramitaṃ saṃsāraduḥkham | aprameyeṇa puṇyena grahaḥ | [1.23] kasyetyādinedṛkcittaviśeṣasyāsādhāraṇyam uktam | kasyeti sāmānyena sattvasya | mātur ityādir vā tasyaiva viśeṣaḥ |
devatānāṃ somavaruṇādīnām | ṛṣīṇāṃ vā śiṣṭādīnām | bhūtā bhavanti vā dūra eva bhaviṣyaty api na kasyacid bodhisattvād anyasya | [1.24–25] teṣām eva mātrādīnāṃ co yasmād eṣa manorathaḥ sarvaduḥkhāpanayanasarvaguṇādhāna viṣayo notpannaḥ || ayam ity anantarakathitaguṇaḥ | kutaḥ kathaṃ cety āścarye | yasya parārthāśayo ’smād anyeṣām ||
[1.26] jagadānandeti bodhicittadvāreṇāpy asty anuśaṃsā | [1.27] katham etad ity āha | hitāśaṃsanamātraṃ pratipattirahitaṃ praṇidhicittaṃ viśiṣyate viśiṣṭo bhavati | udyamāt prasthā(3v)nātmanaḥ || [1.28] sattvānāṃ svayam eva hitāhitaprāptiparihārayoḥ pravīṇatvāt kiṃ saukhyārtham udyamenety āha duḥkham iti |
kṣudādiduḥkhaniḥsaraṇāśayā prāṇātipātādibhir duḥkham eva nārakādikam | [1.29] sarvasukhaiḥ kāyikacaitasikaiḥ | [1.30] evaṃ viharato bodhisattvasya yat puṇyaṃ tādṛśaṃ kuto vānyasya | [1.31] tathā hi | kṛte upakṛte pratikurvīta pratyupakuryāt |
avyāpārita upakārakaraṇena pratyupakāre ’pravartitaḥ san sādhus tu hitakārī bodhisattvaḥ kim ucyatāṃ kiṃ tasya māhātmyam ucyatām avāggocaratvāt | [1.32] kutsitam aśanam apraṇītatvāt | satiraskāraṃ sattrāgāraṃ praviśatāṃ khaṭacapeṭādiprāhārāt | mātreṇa vastrādidānavyavacchedaḥ | tena ca prakarṣeṇa divasārdhaṃ yāpyate |
madhyāhne bhukte sāyam āhārārānveṣaṇāt | karaṇe cāyaṃ lyuṭ | [1.33] bodhisattvasya punar etadviparīta dānaśālinaḥ sutarāṃ pūjyatvam ity āha kimv iti | iyattārahitebhyaḥ sattvebhyo niravadhikālaṃ sakalamanorājyasya samyak prapūrakam | gaganopamasya janasya gaganasya janasya ca vā parikṣayāvadhitvād akṣayaṃ (4r) tayor akṣayatvāt |
dānaṃ bhaktācchādanādikaṃ prayacchataḥ kimu na syāt pūjyatvam | nitarāṃ syād ity arthaḥ | [1.34] evaṃbhūte bodhisattve parārthaikarase prasādāprasādau sukhaduḥkhahetū iti yatnataḥ svīkartavyaparihartavyāv iti darśayati itīti | [1.35] evam uktena krameṇa tataḥ pūrvapāpakarmavipākaphalāt puṇyavipākaphalam adhikam |
nanu bodhisattve kaluṣam aprasannatvaṃ śakyaṃ na prasannatvam iti cet | āha mahateti | balena kaṣṭena subhāvitakāyavāṅmanaskatayā | śubhaṃ prasādādi rūpam || [1.36] saṃprati bodhicittasya bahvanuśaṃsatayā + + + + prasādo granthakāraḥ tadutpādā śrayabhūtāni bodhisattvaśarīrāṇi bodhisattvāṃś ca sabhājayati yatreti | tad ity anantaroktam |
apiḥ saṃbhāvanāyām | kiṃcin nimittam upakalpyāpakārakaraṇāt | niḥśreyasādisukhānubandhī maitrībalajātakapañcakādivat || [1. col.] bodhicittānuśaṃsaparicchede smṛtiḥ || ||
[2.1] idānīṃ buddhabodhisattvapūjāpūrvakaṃ saṃvaro grahītavya iti tāṃ manomayīm āha taccittetyādinā | [2.7] kasmāt punar manasaiva pūjā samarthyate na sākṣād ity āha apuṇyavān asmīti | [2.9] samatikramāmīti śabdeṣv anādarād gṛhṇatetyādi(4v)vat | [2.10] ratnojjvaletyādinā punar api mānasīṃ pūjām āha | [2.20] ataḥ param ityādinā sāmānyena pūjoktā |
[2.27] viśuddhe santāne jhaṭiti saṃvara ārohatīti tadviśuddhaye vijñāpayāmītyādinā pāpadeśanām āha | [2.30] ratnatraya ityādinā yathāpradhānam āha | kṣepād vikṣepāt | [2.31] aneketyādinā + + + + | [2.33] kathaṃ cetyādinā pāpe saṃvegam | [2.36–37] apriyā na bhaviṣyantītyādau tat tad ityādinopapattim |
[2.44] kiṃ punar ity evaṃ saṃvega ity āha aṅgacchedeti | [2.51] taṃ cāvalokitaṃ nāthaṃ prati | [2.53] yamadūtayakṣarākṣasabhūtapretādayaḥ | vajriṇaṃ vajrapāṇim | [2.55] itvaravyādhītyādinātmānaṃ vigarhate | itvaro ’cirasthāyī | śatam akālamṛtyavaḥ | ekaḥ kālamṛtyuḥ | ete ca vātapittaśleṣma saṃnipātaiḥ kriyante |
iti catur uttarāṇi catvāri śatāni vyādhayo bhavanti | [2.56] ekenāpi kupitena | yata iti yeṣu vyādhiṣu yeṣāṃ ca vyādhīnām |
kāśirāje hi pūrvam asminn eva bhagavati padmanāmadheye + + + jambūdvīpakā manuṣyā mahatā duścikitsenātrādhenāghrātāḥ svām avasthāṃ rājñe nive + + nā (?) + tena ca + + + + cikitsatety (?) ākāya (?) vaidyā ājñā(5r)pitā rohita matsyamāṃsaṃ mahārājaikaṃ bheṣajaṃ tac ca na prāpyata iti parihṛtavanta iti jātakam upaneyam |
[2.58] vigarhāyāṃ hetur atyapramatta iti | yojanasahasraparimāṇe ’vīcyādau | dīrghakālike mahākalpādinākṣīyamāṇāyuṣke kimu na tiṣṭhāmi | [2.59] tasmād adyaiveti | [2.61] gurūṇāṃ buddhādīnām | [2.64] bālena pṛthagjanena | [2.66] pratigṛhṇantu jānantu | na bhadrakam ity akaraṇasaṃvaraḥ || [2. col.] dvitīye smṛtiḥ || ||
[3.1] narakādiduḥkhasya tadgatiṣu tad anubhūya devādau sukṛtaphalasukhānubhave viśramo vicchedo yasmāt tat | atra (anu?) karaṇasya paścāt | dhātūnām anekārthatvāc chādye praśaṃsami (?) | pramā[=sā/mo]dasyopalakṣaṇatvāt varṣajā _ _(?)tathā vidhavacanoccāraṇalakṣaṇābhyāṃ kāyavāgbhyām api | sukham iti |
yadarthaṃ tais tat karma kṛtaṃ tat teṣāṃ saṃpadyatām ity arthaḥ || [3.2] laukikakuśalānumodanānantaraṃ lokottaraśubhānumodanā saṃsāretyādinā | nirmokṣo bodhidvayaṃ taccittaṃ vā | [3.8] kalpasya śastrarogābhyāṃ durbhikṣeṇa vinirgamaḥ | divasān sapta māsāṃś ca varṣāṇi ca yathākramam ||
[3.9] nānopakaraṇāni śayanāsanavasanabhojanābharaṇa(5v)vilepanādīni | [3.10] tyajāmi sattvebhyo dadāmi | śubhaṃ dānamayādikam | pratyupakāravipākādinirapekṣaḥ || [3.11] sarveṣāṃ sāsravātmabhāvādīnāṃ tyāgaḥ | [3.12] yathā prahārādinā sukhaṃ yasmād asau tathā | [3.13] vilasantu mama skandhādau galitvā savilāsaṃ tiṣṭhantu | anayā samaviṣamarūpayā |
[3.14] yāni teṣāṃ sukhāvahāni yathā bhavanti tathā bhavanti | anavadyānīty arthaḥ || [3.16] abhyākhyāsyanti mithyādūṣaṇayā | utprāsakā upahāsakāḥ | tathānye ’py udāsīnaprasannāḥ | [3.20–21] tathā dhāraṇayānāvagāha śītatāpāpanodādiprakāreṇa | etac cātmabhāvān ityādinā (*ātmabhāvādi?)dānam uktam ||
[3.22] idānīṃ kṣaṇasaṃpado durlabhatāṃ bodhi cittotpādasya ca mahānuśaṃsatām avagamya taccittetyādinā pūjām ātmabhāvādidānaṃ ca vidhāya prayogasaṃpanno yathā gṛhītam ityādinā bodhicittam utpādayati | bodhicittaṃ parārthāya samyaksaṃbodhikāmatā | [3.31] mathanaṃ śrutamayyādiprajñayā vicāraṇam | [3.32] tasyās tasyā gater āgatā abhyāgatāḥ |
etac ca sukhasattratvaṃ yogyatayā | [3.33] sukhena cābhyudayikena | antarā madhye yāvad bodhau na pratiṣṭhāpyata iti || [3. col.] tṛtīye smṛtiḥ || ||
[4.1] (6r) pṛṣṭhapuṣṭim abhidhāya pratipattisārasya bodhir ity evam ityādinā pratipattiṃ pratipādayitum upakramate | sudṛḍhaṃ jīvitātyaye ’py aparityāgāt | tandrir ālasyaṃ tadrahitaḥ | [4.2] kuryāṃ na vety evaṃ saṃśayo ’bhyupagamyāpi yujyate | [4.4] buddho bhaveyaṃ jagato hitāyety evaṃ pratijñāya | karmaṇānurūpavyāpāreṇa | visaṃvādya pratārya |
kā gatir durgater anyā | [4.5] tathā hi manaseti | [4.6] vacasā tu sutarām | [4.7] nanv āryaśāriputreṇa bodhicittam utpādya bodhisattvacaryāṃ caratā daśa buddhasahasrāṇy ārādhya māraviheṭhitena bodhicittaṃ parihṛtyāpi śrāvakabodhim adhigamya bahūnāṃ sattvānām arthaḥ kṛtaḥ | tad etat katham ity āha vettīti | acintyārvācīnaiḥ | tān prativiṣayān |
etac ca bodhicittatyāge ’pi mukticittātyāgāt || [4.8] tenaiveti pratijñāya sattvārtham udyuktatvenaiva | [4.11] āpattibalataḥ pṛṣṭhata ākṛṣyate | bodhicittabalena cāgrato nīyate || [4.12] taleneti durgatiparamparayādhastādgamanāt || [4.13] nanu kasyacit tathāgatasya samavadhānāt sugatir eva te saṃpatsyata ity āha aprameyā iti |
[4.14] tasmād adyāpi cet tathaive(6v)ti śikṣāsamvaraśithilo ’kuśalād anivṛteḥ | chedaḥ karacaraṇādīnāṃ churikādinā | bhedas teṣām eva kuntādinā | [4.15] īdṛśī sāmagrī durlabhā | ato ’traiva yatnaḥ kartum ucita ity āha kadeti | mānuṣyam akṣaṇarahitam | kuśalābhyāsayogyatvam indriyāvaikalyāt | [4.16] nirupadravaṃ caurādibhayavirahāt ||
[4.26] punar api svayaṃ vimṛṣati kathaṃcid apīti | hitabhūmiḥ kṣaṇasaṃpat kalyāṇamitrasaṃparkaś ca | jānann api ca vivekāt | tān eva yān pūrvaṃ nītaḥ [4.28] hastādirahitā amūrtatvāt | [4.30] samudānayitum iti nañā nirdiṣṭasyānityatvāt | [4.31] balina anantaryādihetutvād apratikṛtatvāc ca | [4.34] vyasanāni narakādiduḥkhāni |
[4.35] vadhyaghātakā etatprasūtatvād yamadūtādipratibhāsasya | matigṛhe yal lobhamayaṃ pañjaraṃ tatra | [4.36] dhūr iva dhūḥ pratijñā | atra kleśaśatruṣu | [4.37] maraṇāntaṃ hi jīvitam iti svabhāvena maraṇam | [4.38] viṣādena dainyaṃ līna cittatā | vyasanaśatair duḥkhaśataiḥ śramaśatair vā |
[4.39] (7r) akāraṇena paralokādiśuddhiprayojanaviraheṇaiva | [4.42] unmattakas tadā syād [syām?] iti matvā anivartī bhaviṣyāmi | [4.43] nanu kleśaprahāṇābhiniveśasyāpi kleśatayā prahātavyatvāt katham anivartitvādikam ity āha anyatreti | ye kleśāḥ saṃbodhy antarāyās te praheyāḥ | ye tu tadvidhās te saṃbhāraparipūriṃ yāvan na hantavyā ity arthaḥ ||
[4.44] nanu ciraparicitatvena duruddharatvāt kleśaṃ praty anavanatir eva śreyasīty āha galantv iti | [4.45] nirvāsitasyetyādinā kleśaśatroḥ sūddharatvam āha || [4. col.] caturthe smṛtiḥ || ||
[5.1] gṛhītabodhisattvasaṃvareṇa vihitapratiṣiddhayoḥ pravṛttiparihāralakṣa(7v)ṇā śikṣā yathā śakyā tad āha śikṣām ityādinā | [5.2–8] etena prabandhena cittam eva pradhānam ādarśitam | [5.9] nanu dāridryāpanayanādilakṣaṇaṃ dānādi | tat kathaṃ tatrāpi cittaṃ pradhānam ity āha adaridram iti | [5.10] sarvasvaṃ bāhyādhyātmikam |
[5.11] śīlapāramitā dayas tu sutarāṃ cittarūpā ity āha matsyādaya iti | ādiśabdāt paradravyaparadāramṛṣāvādādiviṣayāḥ | yato ’nyatra nayanenādarśanāt | na mārayeyam ity upalakṣaṇān na hareyam ityādikam api | [5.12] mārite tatkṛtāpakārāgaṇanāt | māritāḥ sva kāryakrodhākaraṇāt | (22r) [5.13] bhūmim ityādinaitad eva sanidarśanam āha ||
[5.15] sahāpītyādinā vīryasya kuśalotsāharūpasya cittasvābhāvyaṃ spaṣṭam | kāyavāksahitasyāpi kuśale mandapracārasya | na tat tādṛśam | paṭoḥ kuśale dakṣasya | brahmatvabrahmapurohitatvādikaṃ yādṛśam || [5.16] dhyānaṃ tu cittaikāgratālakṣaṇaṃ cittam evety āha japā iti | tapāṃsi śrāmaṇeravratādīni |
anyatrāsaktena middhādyupahatena vā cittena vṛthaivātyantakṛśaphalatvād abhimatakārye ’nupayogād vā || [5.17] prajñā tu nirvivādaṃ cittam evety āha duḥkhaṃ saṃsāram | sukhaṃ nirvāṇam | ākāśāvakāśasthāyitvād ambare | niṣphalaṃ pañcāgnisevāśiroluñcanādy anutiṣṭhantaḥ |
dharmāṇāṃ sva(22v)lakṣaṇadharaṇād vastūnāṃ sarvaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ svam ātmā cittarūpatvāt sarvavastūnām | bālānām agocaratayā cittaṃ guhyaṃ na bhāvitaṃ vivecikayā buddhyā punaḥ punar na sthirīkṛtam | tasmād iyam api vivecakabuddhirūpatvāc cittam evety arthaḥ ||
[5.18] yasmād evaṃ cittam eva sarvatra pradhānaṃ tasmāt svadhiṣṭhitaṃ smṛtyā surakṣitaṃ saṃprajanyena | evaṃ saṃvaravatā manasikāryam | [5.20] saṃghātanarakaprabhavameṣākāra parvatāghātād [smth missing here?] [5.21] durjanāḥ kṣānteḥ pramadāś ca śīlabhraṃśasyeti dvayodīraṇam | na khaṇḍyate āpatty ādhyācāreṇa na śīlād bhraṣṭaḥ kriyate |
[5.22] punar evaṃ dravayitavyaṃ cittam ity āha lābhā iti | [5.23] añjaliḥ kriyate ’ñjaliṃ kṛtvā prārthanā kriyate | ki(23r)martham | smṛtiṃ ceti | naikaikena cittaṃ rakṣituṃ śakyam iti parasparāpekṣayā cakāradvayam | tatra vihitapratiṣiddhayor yathāyogaṃ smaraṇaṃ smṛtiḥ |
kāyacittāvasthayoś caraṃś carāmīti raksamāno rakṣe ityādipratyavekṣaṇaṃ saṃprajanyam || [5.24] sarvakarmasu gamanabhojanādiṣu | tathābhyāṃ vyākulaṃ vikalam | sarvakarmasu pāṭhasvādhyāyādiṣu || [5.26] aneka ity asaṃprajanye ’paraṃ dūṣaṇam || [5.27] asaṃprajanyety aparam | cauraḥ kuśaladhanāpahārāt | rakṣa pālikāyāḥ smṛter moṣānusāriṇā |
muṣitā viluptakuśala dhanāḥ | [5.28] etad eva spaṣṭayati kleśeti | piśācādivac chalagaveṣakaḥ | prāpyāvatāram asaṃprajanyarūpam || [5.29] smṛtim adhikṛtyāha tasmād iti | yasmāt smṛter abhāve saṃprajanyābhāvād iyanti dūṣaṇāni (23v) tasmāt | mana eva dvāraṃ kleśānāṃ tenaiva santānagṛhe praveśāt | sā ca smṛtis tīvrādarād utpadyate |
so ’pi śamatha māhātmyam avagamya || [5.30] keṣāṃcid anyathāpi smṛtir utpadyata ity āha upādhyāyeti | labdhaparipālanāya śikṣaṇam anuśāsanī | avavādo ’py upalakṣaṇāt | tathācāryatadanyārādhyabrahmacārigrahaṇam | pāṭhasvādhyāyādau tātparya kāriṇāṃ puṇyavatām | sukaram akaṣṭam | [5.32] akuśale lajjā trapā | śikṣāyām ādaraḥ | tadatikramād bhayam |
tatheti smṛtikāraṇasamuccaye | buddhabodhisattvānusmṛtir apīty anuśaṃsāntaram | [5.33] saṃprajanyotpattisthityor api smṛtir eva kāraṇam ity āha saṃprajanyam iti | kleśacaurebhyaḥ kuśaladhanarakṣārtham || [5.34] niṣphalasyandaniṣedhārtham āha pūrvam iti | cakṣurādivyāpāraśūnyatvāt kāṣṭhavat | (24r) [5.35] etad eva vyanakti niṣphalā iti |
[5.36] ābhāsamātraṃ mānuṣasya saṃnidhīyamānasya chāyāmātraṃ svāgatabhāṣaṇārthaṃ pūrvābhibhāṣitvād bodhisattvānām | [5.37] bhayaṃ cauravyāghrādi | caturdiśaṃ krameṇa | samāhāro 'yam | pṛṣṭhato diśaḥ parāvṛtyaiva sakalagātreṇa vīkṣeta na punaḥ paścādgrīvam anācārāt || [5.38] sared agrataḥ | apasaret paścāt | prāṇātipātaprapātapatanādiparihārārtham |
sarvāsu śayanādiṣu | svaparahitaṃ prayojanam avagamyānutiṣṭhet || [5.39]

[6.81] na stotṝṇāṃ sukham aniṣṭaṃ kiṃ tarhi tatstutyabhiprasannais tasya satkāro ’nabhipreta ity āha trailokyeti | [6.82] lābham apy upalakṣaṇāt | puṣṇātīti lābham abhisaṃdhāya | [6.85] prasannān dāpakādīn guṇaviśeṣaṇaṃ vā | [6.88] evam iti paraduḥkhe tuṣṭirūpo ’rthaḥ || [6.89] etat parānarthacittam | krītvā subodham | nītveti pāṭhāntaram |
[6.90–91] stutyādivighāte ’pi kṣobho ’yukta ity āha stutir iti | pañcaiva puruṣārthā ity etāvāṃś cety uktam | nanu mānasasukhārthaṃ stutyādi | gaṇikā paradārādi ca | saddharmaśravaṇādijaṃ ca saumanasyaṃ puṇyasaṃgṛhītam evety adoṣaḥ || [6.92] bālajanollāpa kāriṇaś ca stutyādayo nādaraṇīyā ity ā(12v)ha yaśo’rtham iti |
hārayanty arthaṃ hastyaśvādidānāt | saṃgrāmam ārūḍhā ātmānaṃ mārayanty api | akṣarāṇi stutyādirūpāṇi ca kiṃ bhakṣyāṇi | tāny api nirarthakāni | yaśo’rthaṃ mṛte kasya ca tad yaśaḥśravaṇajaṃ sukham | [6.93] tasmād bālakrīḍāprakhyam etat | yatheti | svacittaṃ duḥkham āviśat | [6.94–95] kiṃ ca śabdas tāvad iti | anyatra madanavimateḥ |
[6.96] sarvatraiveti | anyatrābhiprasādena sukhite ’pi mamāstu tat sukhitvam | tasmāt tatsukhena sukhitvam iti vāṅmātram | [6.97] tasmād iti na punaḥ parasukhena sukhitvāt | evam uktena prakāreṇa | atrāpi hi tasyaiva tat prītisukham || [6.98] stutyādayaś cāpakāritayopekṣām evārhantīty āha stutyādayaś ceti | kṣemam alabdhalābham |
saṃvegaṃ saṃsārāt | mamaiva lābhādi(13r)rūpasaṃpad yuktā nānyeṣām iti tasyām amarṣaṃ ca || [6.102] kuśalāntarāyakāriṇy api kṣameva yuktety āha puṇyavighna iti | tat puṇyakāraṇaṃ puṇyavighnakārichalenāyatnamilitam | [6.103] ātmadoṣeṇāsahiṣṇutvena | vighnaḥ puṇyasya | etat kṣamāphalam adhigamaphalam || [6.109] siddhihetuḥ kuśalaniṣpattihetuḥ |
[6.110] tasya duṣṭāśayam | hite yasmāt kṣāntir na yuktā [6.111] ataḥ | sa eveti yasyāśayaṃ pratītya abhimatasiddhau ced upayujyate etāvataivopādeya ity arthaḥ | [6.112] saṃbhāra śasyaprasūti pravṛddhihetutvād ubhayaṃ kṣetram iva kṣetram | ataḥ kṣāntyādihetutvena buddhatvahetutvāt | [6.113] buddhadharmā daśabalādayaḥ ||
[6.114] bhagavatām anuttare ’py āśayamāhātmye tena kāryeṇa buddhatvarūpeṇa te(13v)na hetunā te sattvā buddhaiḥ samāḥ || [6.115] maitryāśayas tv ityādinā pratiniyatātmagataṃ viśeṣam āha | pūjyo jinaiḥ | tat tasyaiva maitryāśayasya sattvasya māhātmyam || [6.116] aṃśo bhāgaḥ prakāro vā | [6.117] kvacit sattve | [6.118] tarhi kimiti sattvārādhanam |
buddheti | [6.119] niśchadmabandhavo buddhā bodhisattvāś ca | niṣkṛtir nistaraṇaṃ pratyupakāraḥ || [6.120] prabhucittānuvartina eva saṃpada iti sattvārādhanam eva kāryam ity āha bhindantīti | [6.121] svāminaḥ suteṣu | [6.122] manyuḥ khedaḥ | [6.126] ātmīkṛtaṃ sarvatragadharmadhātu prativedhāt samatayā parātmaparivartanena vā ||
[6.127] anekaprayojanasādhakatayāpi sattvārādhana eva yatitavyam ity āha tathāgateti | etad eva sattvārādhanam eva | svārthasya buddhatvasya tatsaṃbhārasya vā | duḥkhāpahaṃ tadupa(14r)śamahetubuddhatvāvāhakatvāt | [6.128] āgāmibhityāpi parāpakārād virantavyam ity āha yatheti | [6.129] aparāddhaṃ sāparādham |
[6.131] kiṃ ca roṣe toṣe vā yathā sattve ’pakārina upakāriṇo vā na tathā rājety āha kupita iti | kiṃ duḥkhaṃ yena duḥkhena kṛtena | [6.132] yad buddhatvam || [6. col.] ṣaṣṭhe smṛtiḥ ||
[7.1] arśa āditvād atikṣamaḥ kṣamāvān | anyathā duḥkhāsahanatayā vīryaviccheda eva syāt | puṇyasyopalakṣaṇatvāj jñānam api | ubhayahetutayā vīryasya bodhikāraṇatvāt | [7.2] kiṃ vīryam ityādinā praśnapūrvakaṃ vīryam eva savipakṣaṃ vibhajate | kuśale dānādāv utsāha udyamaḥ | akuśale tu kauśīdyam eva | ālasyaṃ kāyamanasor akarmaṇyatā |
kutsite hāsyalāsyādau | viṣādena duṣkare karmaṇi viṣa(14v)ṇṇatayā | ātmanaḥ kva mama bodhir ity avajñā || [7.3] tatrālasyaṃ hantuṃ tatkāraṇaṃ tāvad āha avyāpāreti | nirvyāpāratayā sukhāsvādena middhena cāpāśrayatṛṣṇā masūrakādyavaṣṭambhanābhilāṣas tayā yaḥ saṃsāraduḥkhānudvegas tasmāt | yadvāsmād evāvyāpārasukhāsvādādikaṃ yat tena |
[7.4] saṃsāraduḥkhānudveganivṛttyartham āha kleśavāguriketi | kleśā eva vāgurikā jālikāḥ | tair āyattīkṛto yasmāt praviṣṭo janmajālam | adyāpy etaddaśāprāptikāle ’pi || [7.5] svayūthyān ity aparaṃ saṃsārodvegakāraṇam | yūthaṃ vargaḥ | tadbhavāḥ samānavayaskāḥ sahakrīḍanakāḥ | [7.7] yāvad iti yadā | saṃbhṛta saṃbhāraḥ saṃpūrṇasāmagrīkaḥ |
[7.8] idam ityādinaitad eva samarthayate | ida(15r)m ity anāgataṃ yat kartum iṣṭaṃ tan na prāptam | idaṃ kartum ārabdham ardhakṛtaṃ sthitaṃ sarvātmanāniṣpannatvāt | akasmād atarkitopanataḥ || [7.9] śokaḥ priyaviyogajas tāpaḥ | vego ’nivāryāvṛttiḥ | [7.11] jīvayuktā matsyā jīvamatsyāḥ | ihaivāṭyagrāvasthāyām |
[7.12] avyāpārasukhāsvādanivṛttaye prāha spṛṣṭa iti | svasthaṃ nirvyāpāratayā saviśvāsam | [7.13] aparam apy avyāpārasukhāsvādaprasaktaṃ praty āha nirudyameti | sukhahetusukṛtotpādane | sukumāra duḥkhāsahiṣṇutayā | atha ca duḥkhahetau pravṛtteḥ prabhūtam apīha | amaram ātmānam ākaroty ullikhatīti tadākāra iti viparyaste heti karuṇā |
vihanyase vighātavān bhavasi | ātmānam eva vā evaṃ prabodhayati | evam anyatrāpi yathāyogam | [7.14] (15v) nidrāparādhīnaṃ praty āha mānuṣyam iti | aṣṭākṣaṇavinirmuktam || [7.15] ālasyaṃ nivārya kutsitāsaktiṃ nivārayati | muktveti | dharme sukṛte ratir anantā prītisantatir yasyāḥ sā tathā | auddhatyaṃ kāyacetasor vikṣepaḥ | hāsyaṃ vāgauddhatyam |
ādiśabdād gītādikam | [7.16] viṣādātmāvamanyanāṃ vīryavipakṣaṃ nirasyann aparam api tadvipakṣanirākṛtaye prāha aviṣādeti | aviṣādo ’vairasyam | balānāṃ vakṣyamāṇānāṃ vyūhaḥ samūhaḥ | tātparyaṃ naipuṇyam | ātmavidheyatā svavaśavartitā | etāḥ kṛtadvandvatayā | eṣā cāpūrvaiḥ sahitā | parātmasamatāparātmaparivartane ca dhyānaparicchede vakṣyete |
idam api samastaṃ kauśīdyaprahāṇāyety uddeśaḥ | [7.17] tatrāviṣādaṃ tāvan nirdiśati | naivāvasāda i(16r)ti | ity ata evamākārān manasikārāt | [7.18] idaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ te ’pītyādikam | te ’pi śākyamunyādayaḥ pūrvam | [7.19] kimutātiśayena | tataś ca sarvajñanīter heyopādeyapratipādikāyā atyāgāt | kiṃ naiva na ||
[7.20] ato ’pīti cittam eva saṃsthāpayati | gurau saṃsāraduḥkhe laghv iti laghuni ca bodhyarthaṃ duṣkaraduḥkhe gurv iti mūḍhatvaṃ viparyastatvam avicārāt | [7.21] etad evāha chettavya iti | tattatkarmavaśāc chettavyaḥ karacaraṇādichedanān narakādau bhettavyaḥ śaktikuntādibhir dāhyo nārakadahanādinā pāṭyo jvalitakrakacādinā |
na ca bodhir etena duḥkhena tatsaṃbhārānārjanāt | [7.22] etat kveti duṣkaracaryāsamuttham | parimitam alpakālatvāt | yāvajjīvikanaṣṭaśalya vyathānirāsanimittam | tadutpāṭanaduḥkhaṃ yathā || [7.23] (16v) ito ’pi duṣkaram anuṣṭheyam ity āha sarve ’pīti | kriyā laṅghanapācanādikā tajjanitair duḥkhaiḥ | bahūni jātyādīni | alpakaṃ bodhicaryārūpam ||
[7.24] na cemāṃ śiraśchedādirūpām ucitām api kriyām ādikarmikebhyo varavaidyo bhagavān dattavān na vihitavān | yasmāt sukumāreṇopakrameṇa | mahāturān dīrghakālikarāgādirogagrastān | [7.25] madhuram evopacāram āha ādāv iti | śakyaparityāgaśākasaktupiṇḍakādimātradāne ’pi |
tad iti tathā karoty upāyaviśeṣeṇa yad yathā krameṇa dānābhyāsāt svamāṃsāny api tyajet | [7.26] katham etad duṣkaraṃ kuryād ity āha yadeti | dānābhyāsaprakarṣān nairātmyābhyāsād vā yadā || [7.27] nanu sāṃsārikaṃ duḥkhaṃ dīrghakālikaṃ katham iva sahyam ity āha na duḥkhīti | na duḥkhī tya(17r)ktatrividhapāpatvāt |
paṇḍitatvād ubhayanairātmyaniścetṛtvāt | mithyākalpanātmātmīyakalpanā | [7.28] hetuvirahād duḥkhābhāvaṃ vibhāvya hetusadbhāvāt sukham eveti darśayann āha puṇyeneti | ittham ubhayasukhānvitaḥ kṛpāvān | kena duḥkhena naiva kenacit | atha kena hetunā duḥkha hetor abhāvān na kenacit ||
[7.29] nanv avilambāc chrāvakabodhir eva prekṣāvatām upādeyety āha kṣapayann iti | [7.30] evam ity aviṣādam upasaṃharati || [7.31] chandasthāmetyādinā balavyūhoddeśaḥ | tatra chandaḥ kuśalābhilāṣa utsāhād anyaḥ | sthāmārabdhadṛḍhatā | ratiḥ satkarmāsaktiḥ | muktir aśaktau tāvatkālam ārambhaparihāraḥ |
etaccaturaṅgaṃ balaṃ sattvārthasiddhaye vīryahetutvād asya vīryasya ca sarvasampatkaratvāt || tatra bahukaratvāc chandasya (17v) tāvad utpattinimittam āha chandam iti | aśubhajanitanārakādiduḥkhabhayāc chandaṃ kuśalābhilāṣam | anuśaṃsāś ca kuśalānām evārthāt || [7.32] samprati balavyāpāram āha evam iti | uktaprabandhanītyā | vipakṣam ālasyādi |
unmūlya pratipattyābhyāsena | mānaḥ sthāmaiva | tātparyavaśite balavyūhād anantaram uddiṣṭe | āsāṃ sāmarthyaiḥ | [7.33] tatra chandotpādanam āha aprameyā ekaikasyāpi rāgāder anantabhedatvāt | [7.34] doṣakṣayakaṇo 'pi | [7.36] adbhutaṃ durlabhatvāt | [7.37] ito ’pi viphalaṃ na prāptam iti | kārā upakārāḥ saddharma lekhanāditaḥ |
[7.38] ārtāḥ kāyamanoduḥkhaiḥ | garbhe udare śalyatām || [7.39] kutaḥ punar īdṛśī vipattiḥ | dharmacchandeti | doṣakṣaya leśādyabhāvalakṣaṇā vipattiḥ | iti saṃvegam āvedayati | [7.51] vyatirekam abhidhāyānvayam āha (18r) nīcam iti bhārodvahanādi | mayy api sattvānāṃ dāsībhūte | māno mahārthabhraṃśakārī na tu nīcakarmapravṛttiḥ ||
[7.52] upakleśe mānam āha mṛtam iti | upakleśeṣu nihatamānatayā mano yadi durbalaṃ syāt tadāpad āpattiḥ | alpāpi mṛdūpakleśajanitāpi | yasmān mṛtam iti | [7.53] kutaḥ punar āpadāṃ saṃbhava ity āha viṣādeti | cittonnatirahitasya viṣaṇṇatayā kṛtanirudyamasyāpadaḥ sulabhāḥ | vyutthita upakleśeṣu vipratipannaḥ |
smṛtisaṃprajanyābhyāṃ teṣām anavakāśāya vyāpriyamāṇo mahatām api kleśānām api durjayaḥ | [7.54] tasmād iti sthāmabalaṃ nigamayati | dṛḍhena mānād anivartyena | anyathā trailokyeti | [7.55] kīdṛśaṃ vijigīṣutvam ity āha | siṃhāḥ sarvamāramṛgair adhṛṣya(18v)tvāt || [7.56] tarhi śatruvijayāyāpi māninaḥ praśasyā ity āha ya iti |
mānavijitā mānābhibhūtāḥ | [7.57] kuto mānīti kaḥ punar māne doṣa ity āha māneneti | kathaṃcin manuṣyatve ’pi nirānandāḥ | [7.58] sarvata iti sarvatra sarvebhyaḥ prāpaparibhavāḥ | dīnāḥ kṛpaṇāḥ | [7.59] ke punar mānina ity āha ta iti | sphurantam api prabhavantam api | jane sadevakādau | jayaphalaṃ buddhatvam |
buddhatvāvasthāyām īdṛśaṃ tad iti pratipādayati | vijayino labdhavijayāḥ | śūrās tejasvinaḥ || [7.60] upakleśeṣu mānaṃ pratipādya śaktāv āha | saṃkleśavargamadhyasthaḥ saṃsāritvāt | dṛpto darpiṣṭhaḥ śaktiyogāt | katham | duryodhano durjayatvāt | [7.61] etad eva sadṛṣṭāntam āha mahatsv apīti || [7.62] ratibalam āha yad iti |
karmeti saṃbhāranibandhanaṃ dhyānādhyayanādikam | āpa(19r)dyata āpadi | tasmin karmaṇi vyasanī prasaktaḥ | tatkarmaśauṇḍas tasmin karmaṇi pravṛttilampaṭaḥ | dyūtādikrīḍāyāṃ yat phalaṃ sukhaṃ tadīpsur iva || [7.63] ity api karmaṇi ratir āsevitavyety āha sukhārtham iti | na cāniṣphalasyāpy ārambhasya saṃbhavāt | tathāpi karmaṇo na nivartate lokaḥ |
kasmai ca dhyānādhyayana rūpam | [7.64] idam api cintayatā puṇyakarmaṇy abhirantavyam ity āha kāmair iti rūpādibhiḥ | kṣuradhārālagnamadhūpabhoge tṛṣṇākṛte yathā jihvāchedaduḥkhaṃ tathā kāmair apy upabhuktair jātyādiduḥkham iti tadupamaiḥ | vipāke pariṇatau svargādiphalatvān madhuraiḥ | niḥśreyasā vāhakatayājarāmaratvahetutvāc chivaiḥ |
ata eva puṇyāmṛtair ity uktam || [7.65] tasmād iti karmaṇi ratim evopasaṃhāravyājena draḍhaya(19v)ti | avasānaṃ visarjanasamayaḥ | prāptasarāḥ karīti bahuvrīhigarbhaḥ karmadhārayaḥ || [7.66] muktibalam āha baleti | prārabdhakāryanirvartanaśaktikṣamasyānubandhe prabandhe nānugamena tu kṣaṇamātraṃ nāśe |
paścāt kariṣyāmīty abhiprāyas tāvatkālaṃ muñcet | susamāptaṃ ca yat tad api tyajed aparaviśeṣāpekṣayā | tatra niṣpanne prayatnānupayogāt | ayaṃ ca pūrvaṃ nirūpya sāmagrīm ityāder apavādaḥ || [7.67] balavyūhaṃ sākalyenābhidhāyāviṣādeti prathamam uddiṣṭam api punaś chandādigaṇe ’vaśyakartavyatayā kathitaṃ tātparyaṃ tāvad āha kleśeti |
saṃrakṣan nivārayan | dṛḍhaṃ punaranavakāśena | [7.68] punas tātparyaṃ śikṣayati tatreti | khaḍgaṃ yuddhe | bhraṣṭaṃ smṛtisaṃpramoṣe | skhalite sati smaran | [7.69] nanu sūkṣmadoṣo ’pi kiṃ nopekṣyata i(20r)ty āha viṣam iti | prasarpati prasarati | chidraṃ smṛtisaṃpramoṣarūpam | doṣo ’ṇur api | [7.70] taileti punar anyathā tātparyam āha |
tathā vratī bodhisattvasaṃvaravān | skhalite duḥkhatrāsāt tadanavakāśāya tatparaḥ syāt || [7.71] tasmād ity uktam upasaṃharati | pratikurvīta mukhaprakṣālanālokasaṃjñānityatābhāvanādibhiḥ pratikriyāṃ kuryāt || [7.72] tatparasyāpi skhalite karaṇīyam āha ekaikasminn iti pratyekaṃ smṛtipramoṣāt skhalite | idaṃ skhalitam ||
[7.73] etena skhalitāvakāśavāraṇābhiprāyeṇa hetunā | niṣiddham api saṃsargam ekatrāvasthānaṃ bahuśrutair ācāryopādhyāyādibhiḥ | tanniśritas tiṣṭhed ity arthaḥ | karma vāvavādānuśāsanīrūpam | skhalite daṇḍakarmasvabhāvaṃ vā prāptam āpatitam | kathaṃ nāmeti lokoktyāśaṃsāyām | (20v) āsu kleśāvatāradaśāsu | uktaṃ ca | upādhyāyānuśāsanyetyādi ||
[7.74] ātmavidheyatām āha laghū kuryād iti | laghuḥ śīghrakārī | ātmā pañcaskandharūpaḥ | tathā utsāhābhyāsāt | apramādaḥ kuśaleṣv avadhānam | tatkathāpramādo ’mṛtapadam ityādikā | karmārambhāt prāg eva yathā sajjaḥ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāraḥ syāt sudāntāśvavat | [7.75] uktam evārtham udāharaṇena spaṣṭayati yathaiveti | gatyāgatyor vāyor āyattam |
evam utsāhasyāyattiṃ gacchet | evam ākāśagamanādikā ṛddhir abhyāsaparāyaṇasya sidhyati || [7. col.] saptame smṛtiḥ || ||
[8.1–2] vikṣiptacitto yasmāt kleśānāṃ rakṣasām iva daṃṣṭrā madhye sthitaḥ samādhivipakṣavikṣepanirākaraṇaṃ prastauti kāyeti | vitarkān janapadādigocarān | (21r) upalakṣaṇatvāt kāmachandādīn api | [8.3] tatra lokāparityāgahetuṃ tāvad āha snehād iti | sneho ’bhiṣvaṅgaḥ | lābhasatkārayaśaḥprabhṛtiṣu ca tarṣeṇa |
etasya snehasya lābhāditṛṣṇāyāś ca lokasya cāparityāganimittam | [8.4] śamathena hetunā vipaśyanayā suṣṭhu yuktaḥ samāhita citto yathābhūtaṃ prajānātīty ukteḥ | sarvaloke nirapekṣayānapekṣayābhiratyānabhiratyeti yāvat | [8.5] tam evānabhirati āha kasyeti | anityeṣu putrakalatrādiṣu | kena hetunā | yeneti || prīṇātīti ca priyaḥ |
